scope: OKX same-account USDT perpetual funding-rate ADL spot repair
coverage: orders category=adl retains native order and trade IDs, including negative trade IDs and numeric or empty clOrdId
Only factual USDT SWAP fillSz, fillPx and fillTime create fill evidence; cumulative-only and zero-ID updates do not invent fills
The fills channel rejects non-positive trade IDs and forced-close categories
Cross-channel duplicate and reordered order replay bypasses transport dedup: native fills of 5 plus 2 contracts queue only 0.07 base at a 0.01 multiplier
Liquidation and delivery are recorded without triggering ADL repair; ordinary categories and cancellation source codes are not ADL fills
Shared repair routing supports the five same-venue FundingArb pairs while excluding Exec, cross-venue pairs and other modes
Spot market children use fixed base quantity, banAmend=true and the existing cross mode
New external forced-close uniform records use the canonical FILLED status code
notes: No live orders were submitted and no live OKX ADL event was observed during verification.
OKX VIP fills explicitly excludes ADL; existing orders subscription is the authoritative source.
OKX retains the account autoLoan setting; this patch does not change account configuration or promise a per-order no-borrow mode for cross SPOT.
Repair and deduplication state is process-local; a restart during repair requires reconciling outstanding orders and actual exposure.
Historical ADL records are not automatically replayed into orders.
